greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, iyo wadaagga Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Waxaan ku noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga maalmaha noloshayda oo dhan.
homily:
Waxaa jira saacado maalinta ka mid ah, gaar ahaan marka qorraxdu ay bilaabato inay hoos u dhacdo, oo gurigu uu noqdo mid aamusan, halkaas oo xusuusta ay si tartiib ah u soo gasho qolka. Waxaad arkeysaa wax yar oo maalinle ah: laga yaabee inay tahay xadhigga kabaha oo si qaldan u yaalla, ama buug uu Ben dhigay miiska, ama xataa sawirka diyaarad uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa oo weli derbiga sudhan. Waxyaalahan yaryar, oo aan muhiim u muuqan, ayaa ah meesha aan maanta ka bilaabayno. Waxay yihiin xusuus muujinaysa in nolosha Benjamin Vo ay ahayd mid dhab ah, mid qurux badan, oo weli halkan nala joogta.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'miiska xafladda'. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sheeko ku saabsan boqor diyaariyey xaflad aroos oo weyn. Wuxuu leeyahay: 'Behold, I have prepared my banquet, my calves and fattened cattle are killed, and everything is ready; come to the feast.' Bal ka feker sawirkaas. Ilaah wuxuu inoo diyaariyey miis ay ka buuxaan naxariis iyo nabad. Ben, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba u taagnaa inuu dadka kale la wadaago waxa uu haysto. Xusuusnow sida uu u dhisayey barnaamijyadiisa kombuyuutarka, sida uu ugu qorayey koodhka GitHub, ama sida uu ugu taabtay nolosha dadka kale jacayl aan xad lahayn. Ben wuxuu lahaa qalbi u taagnaa abuuridda, dhisidda, iyo jacaylka. Wuxuu ahaa wiil mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu dadka kale ku casumo farxaddiisa, ha ahaato ciyaaraha, aviation-ka, ama xataa markuu rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay ahaayeen kuwo adag. Waxaa jira waqtiyo aad dareemaysaan in xanuunka uu ka weyn yahay iftiinka. Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkan ku hakinno. Waxaan rabaa inaan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Waxaad siiseen Ben jacayl aan xad lahayn, waalidnimadiinuna waxay ahayd hadiyad uu Ben ku koray. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, markii martidii hore ay diideen, boqorkii wuxuu yiri: 'Go out, therefore, into the main roads and invite to the feast whomever you find.' Ilaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inuu inoo diyaariyey meel. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meeshaas. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven'. Ma jiro baahi loo qabo inuu dhisayo 'con chim airlines', waayo wuxuu ku jiraa meel uu ka arki karo adduunka oo dhan, isagoo dhoola caddaynaya. Waxaad maqli kartaa codkiisa oo leh: 'Baah, waan fiicanahay.' Sida uu aabihiis ku arkay riyadii, Ben wuxuu u muuqday mid caafimaad qaba, xoog leh, oo faraxsan. Taasi waa ballanqaadkii Ilaah.

Bawlos, akhriska labaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'I can do all things in him who strengthens me.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil rumeeyey aayaddan. Wuxuu ku dhex noolaa xoogga Masiixa. Xusuusnow sida uu u ahaa wiil geesi ah, oo mar walba isku dayey inuu wax walba bixiyo. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aaminsan in 'isku daygu uu yahay waxa kaliya ee muhiimka ah'. Hadda, Ben wuxuu ku jiraa meel ka sarreysa daruuraha, meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Waxaad tihiin waalid geesiyaal ah, oo koriyey wiil geesi ah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay: 'Ha ka baqina, waayo waxaan idin sugayaa meel aan dhimasho lahayn.'

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in miiska Rabbiga uu weli idin sugayo, iyagoo idin xusuusinaya in jacaylku uu weligiis noolaan doono. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka ugu barakaysan. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana raba inaan naftayda ku siiyo. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sacrament ahaan, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana isku xirayaa naftayda adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Aabbow, waxaan kuu dhiibnay Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan kuwa dhintay, si aad u siiso nasasho weligeed ah oo ku dhex jirta iftiinkaaga.
Aabbow, u naxariiso dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, gaar ahaan qoyska Ben, u qalbi qabooji oo sii rajo xoog leh oo mustaqbalka ah.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Buurtaan Rabbiga ciidammadu wuxuu dadka oo dhan u diyaarin doonaa xaflad cunto hodan ah iyo khamri la doortay, cunto casiir leh oo hodan ah iyo khamri saafi ah oo la doortay. Buurtaan ayuu ku baabbi'in doonaa daaha dadka oo dhan daboolaya, shabakadda quruumaha oo dhan dusha ka saaran; wuxuu baabbi'in doonaa dhimashada weligeed. Rabbiga Ilaah ahu wuxuu tirtiri doonaa ilmadu weji kasta, ceebta dadkiisa ayuu ka qaadi doonaa dhulka oo dhan; waayo Rabbigu wuu hadlay. Maalintaas waxaa la dhihi doonaa: 'Bal eega Ilaaheenna, ka aynu u eegaynay inuu na badbaadiyo! Kan waa Rabbiga aynu u eegaynay; aynu ku reyreyro oo aynu ku faraxno inuu na badbaadiyey!' Waayo gacanta Rabbiga ayaa ku nasan doonta buurtaan.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Waxaan ku noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga maalmaha noloshayda oo dhan. Rabbigu waa adhijirkayga; waxba uma baahni. Daaqa cagaaran ayuu igu nasinayaa; biyo xasilloon ayuu ii hoggaamiyaa; wuxuu naftayda dib u cusboonaysiiyaa. R. Waxaan ku noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga maalmaha noloshayda oo dhan. Wuxuu igu hoggaamiyaa waddooyin toosan magiciisa aawadiis. In kastoo aan maro dooxada mugdiga ah, shar uma cabsanayo; waayo waxaad ila joogtaa ushaada iyo ulahaaga oo i siiya geesinimo. R. Waxaan ku noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga maalmaha noloshayda oo dhan. Waxaad miis ii hor dhigtaa hortooda cadawgayga; madaxayga ayaad saliid ku subagtaa; koobkaygu wuu buuxdhaafaa. R. Waxaan ku noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga maalmaha noloshayda oo dhan. Keliya wanaag iyo naxariis ayaa i raaca maalmaha noloshayda oo dhan; waxaana ku noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga sannadaha soo socda. R. Waxaan ku noolaan doonaa guriga Rabbiga maalmaha noloshayda oo dhan.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Waxaan ogahay sida loo noolaado xaalado hoose; waxaan kaloo ogahay sida loo noolaado badnaan. Xaalad kasta iyo wax kasta ayaan bartay sirta ah inaan dhergo iyo inaan gaajoodo, inaan hodan noqdo iyo inaan baahdo. Wax walba waan samayn karaa isaga oo i xoojinaya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxay ahayd naxariis inaad qayb ka qaadataan dhibaatadayda. Ilaahayga ayaa si buuxda u siin doona wax kasta oo aad u baahan tihiin, iyadoo la raacayo hodantinimadiisa ammaanta leh ee Ciise Masiix. Ilaaheenna iyo Aabbahayaga, ammaantu ha u ahaato weligeed iyo weligeed. Aamiin.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise mar kale ayuu ugu jawaabay wadaaddada sare iyo odayaasha dadka isagoo adeegsanaya masaallo, wuxuuna yiri: 'Boqortooyada jannada waxaa lala barbardhigi karaa boqor diyaariyey xaflad aroos oo wiilkiisa ah. Wuxuu u diray addoommadiisii inay u yeeraan martidii la casuumay, laakiin way diideen inay yimaadaan. Mar labaad ayuu diray addoommo kale, isagoo leh, "U sheega kuwa la casuumay: 'Bal eega, diyaargaroobay xafladdaydii, dibiyadaydii iyo xoolahaygii cayilnaa waa la qalay, wax walbana waa diyaar; kaalaya xafladda.'" Qaar baa iska indho-tiray casuumaddii oo iska tegey, mid beer buu tegey, mid kalena ganacsi. Intii kalena waxay qabteen addoommadiisii, way u xumaadeen, wayna dileen. Boqorkii wuu cadhooday, wuxuuna diray ciidankiisii, wuxuu baabbi'iyey gacan-ku-dhiiglayaashii, wuxuuna gubay magaaladoodii. Markaasuu ku yiri addoommadiisii, "Xafladdii waa diyaar, laakiin kuwii la casuumay uma qalmin inay yimaadaan. Haddaba u baxa waddooyinka waaweyn oo u yeera xafladda qof kasta oo aad heshaan." Addoommadii waxay u bexeen waddooyinkii, waxayna soo ururiyeen dhammaan kuwii ay heleen, kuwo xun iyo kuwo wanaagsanba, hoolkiina waxaa ka buuxsamay marti. Laakiin markii boqorkii soo galay si uu ula kulmo martida, wuxuu arkay nin aan xiran dharka arooska. Boqorkii wuxuu ku yiri isaga, "Saaxiibow, sidee ayaad halkan u soo gashay adigoon xiran dhar aroos?" Laakiin wuu aamusay. Markaasuu boqorkii ku yiri addoommadiisii, "Gacmihiisa iyo cagihiisa xira, oo ku tuura mugdiga dibadda ah, halkaas oo ay ka jiri doonto oohin iyo ilko-shiidid." Kuwo badan ayaa la casuumay, laakiin kuwo yar ayaa la doortay.'

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
